Combat and equipment

Check four equipment groups before a raid

Before leaving, check your primary weapon and spare ammunition, backup weapon, breaching rockets or C4, and armor and supplies. Prepare medkits, bandages, water and sleeping bags, and repair worn gear first. Do not take all your most valuable items at once; keep emergency equipment in reserve. Consider retaliation when choosing targets: a base close to home is not necessarily a good choice.
